title: Zip Selected
description: Compress highlighted file(s) or folders into archive.zip with multi-selection support

title: Unzip Selected
description: Extract all highlighted archives into individual subfolders (<archive>/)

title: Extract Here
description: Extract archive contents directly into current folder without subdirectories

title: Duplicate This
description: Instantly clone selected file(s) into <name>_copy.<ext> with collision avoidance

title: Trash This
description: Safely move selected item(s) to system trash bin with Freedesktop .trashinfo restore support

title: Move to Downloads
description: Move highlighted file(s) directly into ~/Downloads with collision resolution

title: Move to Documents
description: Move highlighted file(s) directly into ~/Documents directory

title: Move to Desktop
description: Move highlighted file(s) to user Desktop folder

title: Clean Filename
description: Normalize filename: lowercase, replace spaces/special chars with hyphens, trim extra symbols

title: Timestamp Filename
description: Prepend ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD_<name>.<ext>) to all selected files

title: Rename File
description: Rename selected file or sequentially suffix multiple selected files

title: Create New Folder
description: Create a new directory in active file manager folder (defaults to 'New Folder')

title: Copy File Contents
description: Read UTF-8 text/code of selected files (<10MB) directly into system clipboard

title: Save Clipboard Here
description: Write clipboard bitmap to clipboard_<time>.png or text to clipboard_<time>.txt in active folder

title: File Information
description: Report formatted file sizes, permissions, or multi-selection combined tally
